primary.evidenceLevel: Primary static disassembly; no new runtime evidence
observed: UI_CVAR_REGISTER ordinal51 maps sparse index50 to jamp0x4241e4. It maps args1/2/3 through VM_ArgPtr0x44adf0, passes args4 as flags, calls Cvar_Register0x43a350, then returns0.
VM_ArgPtr0x44adf0 tests the input word at0x44adf0; input0 returns pointer0 at0x44adf4/6.

Cvar_Register0x43a350 calls Cvar_Get0x439470 at0x43a353 BEFORE output-pointer test0x43a35b. Null output branches0x43a35d directly to ret0x43a387. Handle/modification writes0x43a378/37a and Cvar_Update0x43a381 only occur for a nonnull output.
The retail uix86 wrapper0x40026900 copies four arguments and pushes ordinal51 at0x40026914 before calling the engine syscall pointer at0x40026916.
Retail UI_Init0x400173e0 sets EBX0 at0x4001740a. Its only subsequent direct EBX write is function-exit pop; EBX is the preserved zero value used in the two following null-output calls.

Retail UI_Init0x400177b8 pushes flags0x800, retrieves current name through0x40003c10, pushes that result, pushes ui_name string0x4003f68c, then pushes EBX0 at0x400177d0 and calls register0x40026900 at0x400177d1.
Retail UI_Init0x4001789c pushes flags EBX0, empty default string0x40032d93, name debug_protocol0x4003ecd4, then pushes output EBX0 at0x400178aa and calls register at0x400178b5.
UI_CVAR_UPDATE ordinal52 maps sparse index51 to0x42421a. It calls Cvar_Update0x43a390, which dereferences the vmCvar pointer at0x43a39b without a null check.
inferenceAndScope: The four-word registration signature is (vmCvar pointer,name string,default string,flags). A null vmCvar registers the actual engine cvar while writing no external vmCvar record; it is not an error or a no-op.

The UI06 host error is consistent with the real retail UI_Init ui_name nullable registration after menu/model initialization. Static evidence proves the call contract; the exact runtime failing cvar name was not separately instrumented.

A host correction should conditionally validate/write the frozen external record only for nonzero args1, and call canonical Cvar_Register(nullptr,name,default,profile flags,privateFlag) for zero args1. Existing null-output UPDATE refusal should remain.
EBX-preserving native calls follow the x86 module calling convention. The observed UI_Init code does not assign a nonzero value to EBX between its zeroing and the nullable calls.
